title: Evaluating Adversarial Robustness of Low dose CT Recovery
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of CT recovery methods' robustness to adversarial attacks. While it mentions the ALARA principle (as low as reasonably achievable) as a motivation for low-dose CT to reduce patient risk, it does not evaluate or benchmark ethical frameworks, morals, or religious/faith aspects. The mention of ALARA serves as a background context for the medical application rather than being the subject of ethical analysis or benchmarking within the paper.
